pairs.subject: conditional-service-composition
pairs.evidence: services/house-seller/src/environment.rs:1 house-seller is one process configured only from a fixed list of environment variables (ENV_NAMES, held to the single-service render.yaml by a test), so no topology is assembled from fragments, overlays, requested handles or probed host capabilities; a search of services/house-seller for overlay, docker-compose, fragment, accelerat, wildcard and profiles found nothing ("compose" only appears as prose in glass.rs), so the subject's precondition of a multi-service topology does not hold.

techniques.evidence: services/house-seller/src/environment.rs:15 Configuration is a fixed list of env variables, not condition-activated fragments, and there are no integration fragments between services.
services/house-seller/src/main.rs:37 Startup reads operator-set env values only. No host capability is probed and no active token set is built.
services/house-seller/src/main.rs:54 Dependencies (ledger, PayPal credentials) are in-process values that fail startup when missing. No service handles need closing.
